cars.name: Toyota GR86 (2022+, ZN8)
cars.brief: NO LOGOS (user decision, overrides anything below): draw no badge, emblem, crest or brand lettering; leave that spot plain body or plain grille, badge=None and no SHOW_BADGE prims. Second-gen Toyota GR86 (2022+). Signature: the large trapezoid lower grille with mesh (relief hex/grid) and the functional corner 'fangs' / side vents, slim headlights with the L-shaped LED DRL (white strokes), the GR86-specific front bumper (no Toyota logo on the grille; small Toyota badge on the nose - simplified three-oval behind SHOW_BADGE), low hood with two creases. Must be clearly different from the BRZ in the same batch (different bumper, lamp graphics).
